name: stb
description: Single-file public domain libraries for C and C++, including stb_image.
summary: The project forbids all use of AI, LLMs and generative AI: AI-written code, documentation, pull requests and issues are not accepted, and AI auto completion, review or analysis of submissions is also prohibited. All contributions must be written by the contributor, in English, even if the English is poor.
